init.title: Estimated pellet consumption
init.description: Optional estimate from whole-hour counters. Blank = unknown. Enter positive finite kg/h. Changing calibration skips the interval through the next valid reading and permanently marks the estimate incomplete.

error.invalid_coefficient: Enter positive finite kg/h values, or leave blank for unknown.
error.invalid_pellet_storage: The pellet estimate storage is invalid. Restore a backup before enabling the estimate. You can disable it without overwriting the file.
